item.title: Nipa MP condemns killing – Tribal Fight at Government Station
item.description: The killing of a young boy at Nipa government station has sparked outrage. Nipa-Kutubu MP Dr Billy Joseph has condemned the violence and called for immediate police reinforcement in the troubled township. Dr Joseph described the brutal killing of the boy from Egenda village as “sickening” and said the retaliatory tribal fight between factions of Egenda and the Ombalpore tribes of Pulim had no place within a government precinct. item.title: 18-year-old executed at 8 Mile
